15–30 min (while the world change is active)

On the {wiki:Thaian-Venorean Road}, west of Venore, a nest of {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} guarded by {creature:Mamma Longlegs} appears. Enter the nest and kill her three times to earn the achievement **Nestling**.
Only while this Mini World Change is active.
Antidotes or the {spell:Cure Poison} spell, and health potions
Check on the {wiki:World Board} that the world change is active before you go.
After you kill Mamma Longlegs three times you can no longer enter the area: you do not need to come back.

This Mini World Change is active when you see one of these messages: *"A whole nest of spiders needs to be exterminated as Mamma Longlegs is on the loose."* or *"Hear ye! Hear ye! Mamma Longlegs will not rest while she guards her cosy nest. Exterminate its kin in there to finally get rid of her."*

Start from **Venore** and head **west/southwest** along the road that links Venore to Thais ({wiki:Thaian-Venorean Road}) to the nest, on the surface (ground floor). There are {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} roaming the area and a small nest.
Inside the nest, fight the {creature:Mamma Longlegs} and kill her. You have to kill her **three times** to earn the achievement.
The spiders poison: bring antidotes or use {spell:Cure Poison}.

The nest is on the surface, so you do not need a rope or other items to leave: walk back the same way, **northeast**, to Venore. After the 3rd death of {creature:Mamma Longlegs} you can no longer enter the area again.
After you get the **Nestling** achievement you can no longer enter the nest area.
